query: select (s.end_time_ticks-s.start_time_ticks)/10000.0 from telemetry_spans s join telemetry_span_attributes a using(trace_id,span_id) where a.attribute_key='url.full' and a.attribute_value like '%/v1.0/state/statestore/%'
meaning: Actual EventStore daprd recorded state-GET span cost, excludes fixture process/HTTP client overhead. No extra multi-second saving claimed.
